# 099 — PR explainer (HIGH tier): one source of truth for the subscription checkout number

## Goal
A human screenshot (2026-07-14) caught the planner's conversion page telling three different money stories for
ONE pick. With only ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) selected at 10.58% blended APY, the headline and the bottom forever
line correctly said **"≈$2,300 covers $20/mo"**, but the right-hand hero (checkout) card said **"$4,800 ONE-TIME
/ generates $42/mo"** — roughly 2× the picked bill. Inconsistent numbers on the `waitlist_submitted` funnel top
directly corrode the trust-rail moat (honest numbers are the whole pitch). This fixes it so all three agree.

## Intuition
Two different interest rates were in play for the same pick:
- When you pick a subscription, the planner **skips the "how much?" step** and seeds a placeholder capital using
  a conservative **guidance rate (~5.5%)**. For $20/mo that's ≈$4,800.
- At the bloom, the headline and forever line **recompute** what the pick really needs at the **live blended
  rate** (10.58%) → ≈$2,300.
The hero card was still showing the ≈$4,800 placeholder (and $4,800 × 10.58%/12 ≈ $42/mo), while everything else
had moved to the live ≈$2,300. There was a state-sync effect meant to reconcile them — but it only ran *after*
the user touched the mix. So the default, untouched state diverged. The fix: let that reconciliation run from
the start.

## What changed and why (reading order)

### 1. `planner.js` — the sync effect (the whole fix)
Before:
```js
// Keep slideCapital in sync with the mix (only when user has touched the mix)
useEffect(function () {
  if (archetype !== 'subscription' || !isCapitalPath || !mixTouched) return;
  var needed = currentMixStats.neededCapital;
  if (needed > 0 && needed !== slideCapital) setSlideCapital(needed);
}, [currentMixStats.neededCapital, archetype, isCapitalPath, mixTouched]);
```
After (gate + dep dropped; comment expanded to explain the seed/bloom rate split):
```js
useEffect(function () {
  if (archetype !== 'subscription' || !isCapitalPath) return;
  var needed = currentMixStats.neededCapital;
  if (needed > 0 && needed !== slideCapital) setSlideCapital(needed);
}, [currentMixStats.neededCapital, archetype, isCapitalPath]);
```
`currentMixStats.neededCapital` is the live-blended-APY forever number for the selected subs — the SAME value the
headline (`subHeroWinCovers`, planner.js:2032) and the forever/mix-total line (`mixTotal`, planner.js:2120)
already display. The hero card reads `slideCapital` (via `chkBaseCapital`, planner.js:2628). By syncing
`slideCapital` to `neededCapital` from the initial seed on, all three converge on one source of truth. It also
means switching persona/APY now refreshes the capital immediately (previously stale until the mix was touched).

Why the ROOT (state) and not just the hero card: the plan strip (planner.js:2758) and the make-it-yours summary
(planner.js:2828) ALSO read `slideCapital`. Patching only `chkBaseCapital` would fix the hero but leave those two
on the stale seed — trading one inconsistency for another. Syncing the state fixes every consumer at once and
keeps the capital slider fully functional.

Why it's safe: the amount step is skipped for subscriptions, so `capital` is ALWAYS a seeded default — there is
no user-typed capital to clobber. And the effect is keyed on `neededCapital`, not `slideCapital`, so dragging the
capital slider (which moves `slideCapital`, not `neededCapital`) never refires it — the user's manual override
still wins.

### 2. `planner.min.js`
Regenerated via `node minify-assets.js` (plan.html + home.html load the min — backlog 053/061/082 precedent).
Only planner.js/planner.min.js changed; the other bundles rebuilt byte-identical.

### 3. `test_hero_number_consistency.js` (new, wired into `npm test`)
Rendered-Playwright acceptance driving the real plan.html UI (never fixtures alone — 2026-07-11 standing
decision). Fixture pool USDC @ 10% (float-safe: foreverNumber($20/mo) = $2,400 exactly, $2,400 yields exactly
$20/mo), URL seeds capital=5000. Asserts (a) an untouched single ChatGPT Plus pick shows the SAME capital
($2,400) and monthly ($20/mo) across the hero card, the instant-win headline, and the forever line, and that the
hero is not the stale $5,000; (b) toggling a second sub re-derives coverage and the hero STILL agrees. Mutation-
proven: 0/2 on a stash-baseline pre-fix build (hero never converges), 2/2 on the fixed build.

## Deviations from spec
None. The spec proposed dropping the gate; that is exactly what shipped. See specs/099-notes.md.

## Trust rails
Untouched — no rail constant, sort, flag, or haircut changed. Every number still derives from live DefiLlama
pool data through the sanity/TVL/anomaly filters and the en-US `formatUsd`/`formatUsdRounded`/`formatApy`
helpers. The change makes the hero honest-by-default (live rate, not a stale guidance rate).

## Verification
- New `test_hero_number_consistency.js`: 2/2 PASS (fixed) / 0/2 FAIL (pre-fix baseline) — mutation-proven.
- Canonical NORTH_STAR Test line: `test_planner.js` (208 assertions), `test_protocol_parsing.js` 9/9,
  `test_qualifier_fix.js` 9/9 — green.
- Adjacent same-page rendered: `test_subscription_mix_seed.js` 4/4, `test_hero_copy.js` 4/4,
  `test_waitlist_microcopy.js` 6/6, `test_minified_assets.js` 9/9 — green.
- `test_waitlist_funnel.js` + `test_waitlist_pitch.js` fail IDENTICALLY on the pre-fix baseline (sandbox blocks
  the formspree POST) → pre-existing & environmental, diff-independent.

Render-path HIGH → needs human visual spot-check (the 003 smoke gate isn't pixel-level; sandbox blocks browser
pixel-QA). No isolable Mixpanel funnel metric (a trust/consistency fix on an existing step) — it protects the
`waitlist_submitted` funnel top rather than adding a new measurable step.
